meta.title: Download and get started
meta.description: Download Capstio for macOS 15 or later, Apple Silicon first. System requirements, supported Linux distributions and the first steps: choose a language, create an SSH key, import hosts from ~/.ssh/config.

title: Get started with Capstio
intro: Download the app to your Mac, connect to your VPS over standard SSH and bring in the hosts you already have. No agent installed on the server.

download.title: Download
download.body: The download button opens the newest Capstio release on GitHub.
download.requirement: macOS 15 or later · Apple Silicon first

server.title: On your VPS
items: SSH access to the server. Capstio uses standard SSH only and installs no agent on the VPS.
Some features need Docker, PM2 or systemd already on the server.
No relay server sits between your Mac and your VPS.

distros.title: Supported distributions
distros.intro: Capstio supports the Linux distributions common on VPS hosts, in three tiers.

tiers.label: Next
tiers.body: Supported right after the first tier.

tiers.label: Limited
tiers.body: They work, but a few features do not apply.

firstRun.title: The first run
firstRun.intro: The welcome screen walks you through a few short steps. You don't need an account for the features on your Mac.

steps.title: Choose a language
steps.body: The app speaks Vietnamese and English.

steps.title: Create an SSH key
steps.body: Create a new SSH key right on the welcome screen, or keep using the keys you have. Keys are stored in the macOS Keychain.

steps.title: Import your hosts
steps.body: Capstio reads the hosts in {~/.ssh/config}, with their user, port and key. Try it with your own config below.

steps.title: Sign in if you need to
steps.body: Signing in is optional, with Google or a code sent to your email. An account is only needed for teamwork and sync.
